_note: A pasted text from a researcher becomes a request: identifiers, the work they point to, what the text asks for, the literal part started at once and proposals that wait for acceptance. Rules are deterministic and versioned; each recognised intent quotes the fragment that triggered it.

url_resolvers._how: Crossref works filtered by ISSN and year; the work whose registered landing page equals the pasted URL (scheme and trailing slash ignored).

fetch._policy: The publisher page is requested once, honestly identified. A bot-protection answer is recorded as such and never worked around.

uses: intents the rules do not cover, each with the quoted fragment that supports it
a methodology proposal read from the paper
model_supplement._why_disabled: A real Vertex call from the app (VM metadata token) was refused by the agent session's permission policy on 2026-10-25 and has not been verified. Until it is, requests use the deterministic rules only and say so.
model_supplement.instruction: You read a message from a researcher and, if given, the text of the paper it points to. Return JSON {"intents":[{"id":<one of intent_ids>,"quote":<exact substring of text>}],"method_notes":[{"statement":<short method step>,"quote":<exact substring of paper>}]}. Only list intents not in 'already'. Every quote must be copied exactly; anything without an exact quote is discarded. Never state numbers that are not in a quote.

cost._source: Assumed price: SerpApi's smallest paid plan, USD 75 per 5000 searches (~EUR 0.014). The account is on the free plan (monthly pool used) and spends extra credits whose price is not known here; the owner should confirm. The cap limits what a request starts by itself.

full_text._how: For every resolved DOI: Europe PMC search by DOI; if the work has a PMCID and is open access, its JATS full text is fetched and converted (jats-text). This is the legal route for PubMed Central papers; publisher pages are never scraped around their protection.

contact._note: Optional contact sent as mailto to Crossref (its 'polite pool'). Empty by default; WatchDog never fills it with an account's address.
